def transform(grid):
    # Crop off the 4 divider row, then combine corresponding cells of the
    # upper color-2 shape and lower binary shape; output marks overlap as 3.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 4)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    out = []
    for r in range(min(len(top),len(bottom))):
        out.append([3 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)])
    return out
PY
